outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle, then closes the gripper around it (frames 74–86, wrist_image). The drawer visibly slides outward, exposing its sides and interior (frames 101–115, image and left_ego_image). The robot releases and withdraws (frames 125–177, wrist_image), leaving the drawer open at frame 177 in image and left_ego_image. No failed acquisition, unwanted object displacement, or damage is visible.
